supports.excerpt:
An area, defined by a bounding topline and baseline, as in an area chart.

- d3.area - create a new area generator.
- area - generate an area for the given dataset.
- area.x - set the x0 and x1 accessors.
- area.x0 - set the baseline x accessor.
- area.x1 - set the topline x accessor.
- area.y - set the y0 and y1 accessors.
- area.y0 - set the baseline y accessor.
- area.y1 - set the topline y accessor.
- area.defined - set the defined accessor.
- area.curve - set the curve interpolator.
- area.context - set the rendering context.
- area.digits - set the output precision.
- area.lineX0 - derive a line for the left edge of an area.
- area.lineY0 - derive a line for the top edge of an area.
- area.lineX1 - derive a line for the right edge of an area.
- area.lineY1 - derive a line for the bottom edge of an area.
- d3.areaRadial - create a new radial area generator.
- areaRadial - generate an area for the given dataset.
- areaRadial.angle - set the start and end angle accessors.
- areaRadial.startAngle - set the start angle accessor.
- areaRadial.endAngle - set the end angle accessor.
- areaRadial.radius - set the inner and outer radius accessors.
- areaRadial.innerRadius - set the inner radius accessor.
- areaRadial.outerRadius - set the outer radius accessor.
- areaRadial.defined - set the defined accessor.
- areaRadial.curve - set the curve interpolator.
- areaRadial.context - set the rendering context.
- areaRadial.lineStartAngle - derive a line for the start edge of an area.
- areaRadial.lineInnerRadius - derive a line for the inner edge of an area.
- areaRadial.lineEndAngle - derive a line for the end edge of an area.
- areaRadial.lineOuterRadius - derive a line for the outer edge of an area.

skill_drafts.name: Area Chart Generator Configuration
skill_drafts.description: Configure and generate area chart shapes by setting baseline/topline accessors, curve interpolation, and rendering context. Use when building area or radial area visualizations from tabular data.
applicable_signals: Dataset with numeric x and y dimensions
Requirement for baseline and topline definition
Need for curve interpolation (linear, cardinal, monotone, etc.)
contraindications: Rendering line charts, scatter plots, or non-area geometries
Data is already pre-rendered or geometry is fixed
workflow_steps: Create a new area generator using d3.area() or d3.areaRadial()
Chain accessor methods: set x0, x1 (or startAngle, endAngle for radial) to define baseline
Chain accessor methods: set y0, y1 (or innerRadius, outerRadius for radial) to define topline
Set rendering context using .context() if canvas rendering is needed
Call the configured generator with dataset to produce path data or render
triggers: Building area or stacked area charts
Need to map data fields to x0, x1, y0, y1 coordinates
Require curve smoothing or custom rendering context
constraints: Data must be array-like with consistent field structure
Accessor functions must return numeric values for coordinates
Curve type must be a valid d3 curve factory
cautions: Ensure accessor functions handle undefined or missing data gracefully
Verify curve type is compatible with area geometry (not all curves suit areas)
Context setting is required for canvas rendering; omit for SVG path output
output_contract: Configured area generator object that accepts a dataset and produces SVG path data (string) or canvas rendering; generator is reusable across multiple datasets with the same structure

metadata.prompt: Chain accessor methods on a d3.area or d3.areaRadial generator to map data fields to coordinates and apply rendering settings. Set x0/x1 (or startAngle/endAngle for radial), y0/y1 (or innerRadius/outerRadius for radial), curve interpolator, and rendering context. Call the configured generator with a dataset to produce SVG path data or canvas output.
metadata.section_summary: D3 is a collection of modules that are designed to work together; you can use the modules independently, or you can use them together as part of the default build.

skill_drafts.name: Radial Area Chart Generator Configuration
skill_drafts.description: Configure and generate radial (polar) area chart shapes by setting angle and radius accessors, curve interpolation, and rendering context. Use when building radial area or rose diagrams from tabular data.
skill_drafts.objective: Generate radial area geometry for charting
applicable_signals: Dataset with angular and radial dimensions
Need for configurable curve interpolation in radial space
contraindications: When polar coordinates are not required
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Create radial area generator', 'detail': 'Call d3.areaRadial() to instantiate a new generator'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Configure angle accessors', 'detail': 'Chain .startAngle(accessor) and .endAngle(accessor) to map data fields to angular position'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Configure radius accessors', 'detail': 'Chain .innerRadius(accessor) and .outerRadius(accessor) to map data fields to radial extent'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Set curve interpolation (optional)', 'detail': 'Chain .curve(curveType) to control smoothing; defaults to curveLinear'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Set rendering context (optional)', 'detail': 'Chain .context(canvasContext) for canvas rendering, or omit for SVG path string output'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Generate area geometry', 'detail': 'Call the configured generator with dataset to produce path data or canvas drawing'}
triggers: Building radial area, rose, or polar area charts
Need to map data fields to startAngle, endAngle, innerRadius, outerRadius
Rendering polar coordinate geometries from tabular datasets
constraints: Accessor functions must return numeric values for angles (in radians) and radii
innerRadius must be less than or equal to outerRadius
Dataset must be iterable and support accessor application
cautions: Angle values should be in radians; convert from degrees if needed
Ensure accessor functions handle undefined or missing data gracefully via defined() method
Rendering context (canvas vs SVG) must be set before generation if using canvas output
output_contract: Configured radial area generator object that accepts a dataset and produces SVG path data (string) or canvas rendering in polar coordinates; output is a closed path enclosing the area between startAngle/endAngle and innerRadius/outerRadius for each data point

examples.input: Dataset: [{angle: 0, radius: 10}, {angle: Math.PI/2, radius: 15}]; Accessors: startAngle=d=>d.angle, endAngle=d=>d.angle+0.1, innerRadius=d=>5, outerRadius=d=>d.radius
examples.output: SVG path string or canvas drawing of a radial area segment in polar space
examples.notes: Demonstrates basic angle and radius mapping for a two-point radial area

examples.input: Rose diagram data with 12 petals; each petal has angle range and variable radius
examples.output: Configured generator produces closed radial area paths for each petal when called with dataset
examples.notes: Common use case for rose/polar area charts

metadata.prompt: Create a radial area generator by chaining accessor methods: set startAngle and endAngle to map angular position, set innerRadius and outerRadius to map radial extent, optionally configure curve interpolation and rendering context. Pass a dataset to the configured generator to produce SVG path data or canvas rendering in polar coordinates.

skill_drafts.name: Area Edge Line Extraction
skill_drafts.description: Extract individual line generators for the edges (baseline, topline, or radius boundaries) of an area shape. Use when you need to render or manipulate area boundaries as separate line elements.
skill_drafts.objective: Derive line geometry from area boundaries
applicable_signals: Area generator is configured and ready
Dataset is prepared for line rendering
Edge styling or manipulation is required
contraindications: Rendering complete area fill without edge separation
Edge lines are not needed or area is already decomposed
Performance-critical context where edge extraction overhead is unacceptable
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Identify area type (Cartesian or radial) and which edge is needed'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Call the corresponding line accessor (lineX0, lineY0, lineX1, lineY1 for Cartesian; lineStartAngle, lineInnerRadius, lineEndAngle, lineOuterRadius for radial)'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Pass dataset to line generator to produce path string or render to context'}
triggers: Need to stroke or style area edges separately
Want to extract baseline or topline as independent line paths
Building composite visualizations with area boundaries as distinct elements
constraints: Line generator must be called on an already-configured area or areaRadial instance
Dataset passed to the derived line generator must match the structure expected by the parent area
Curve interpolator and context settings are inherited from the parent area
cautions: Derived line generators share state with the parent area; changes to parent accessors affect derived lines
Output precision (digits) is inherited from parent area configuration
output_contract: Line generator object ready to accept dataset and produce a path string or render to a specified context. Output is a single line path representing one edge of the original area.

metadata.prompt: Call the appropriate line accessor on a configured area generator to derive a line generator for one edge. For Cartesian areas, use lineX0 (left/baseline x), lineY0 (top/baseline y), lineX1 (right/topline x), or lineY1 (bottom/topline y). For radial areas, use lineStartAngle, lineInnerRadius, lineEndAngle, or lineOuterRadius. The returned line generator accepts the same dataset and produces a path for that edge only.
